name: USDC Permissionless IG Diversified Income
description: Blends the two permissionless sources of return — over-collateralised DeFi lending and permissionless private credit (Syrup) — alongside tokenised RWA income via Ondo Global Markets. It targets an investment-grade-oriented, diversified income profile while keeping to a deliberately small and stable set of markets. Allocation is non-discretionary and rules-based, with programmed rebalancing and CoinShares managing the risk framework only. No leverage, no recursive lending.
assetManagerDescription: CoinShares is a pioneering digital asset investment firm founded in 2014. The company launched the first regulated Bitcoin fund and the first open-ended crypto ETP in Europe. As the market leader with ~45% share of European crypto ETP assets, CoinShares combines deep institutional expertise with a decade-long track record in regulated digital asset management.
